1.text: Ni cyo gituma jyewe Pawulo ndi imbohe ya Kristo Yesu, mbohewe mwebwe abanyamahanga.

2.text: Kandi namwe mwumvise iby'ubutware bwo kugabura ubuntu bw'Imana nahawe ku bwanyu,

3.text: ko mpishurirwa ubwiru bwayo mu iyerekwa nk'uko nabanje kwandika mu magambo make.

4.text: Namwe nimuyasoma muzirebera ubwanyu uburyo menye ubwiru bwa Kristo koko.

5.text: Ubwo ntibwamenyeshejwe abana b'abantu mu bindi bihe, nk'uko muri iki gihe intumwa ze zera n'abahanuzi babuhishuriwe n'Umwuka,

6.text: yuko abanyamahanga ari abaraganwa natwe kandi bakaba ingingo z'umubiri umwe natwe, abaheshejwe n'ubutumwa bwiza kuzagabana natwe muri Kristo Yesu ibyasezeranijwe.

7.text: Nanjye nahindutse umubwiriza wabwo nk'uko impano iri y'ubuntu bw'Imana, iyo naheshejwe n'imbaraga zayo zinkoreramo.

8.text: Nubwo noroheje cyane hanyuma y'abera bose, naherewe ubwo buntu kugira ngo mbwirize abanyamahanga ubutumwa bwiza bw'ubutunzi bwa Kristo butarondoreka,

9.text: njijure bose ngo bamenye uburyo iby'ubwiru bikwiriye kugenda, ari bwo bwahishwe n'Imana yaremye byose uhereye kera kose,

10.text: kugira ngo muri iki gihe abatware n'abafite ubushobozi bwo mu ijuru mu buryo bw'umwuka, bamenyeshwe n'Itorero ubwenge bw'Imana bw'uburyo bwinshi

11.text: nk'uko yabigambiriye kera kose muri Kristo Yesu Umwami wacu.

12.text: Muri we ni mo duherwa ubushizi bw'amanga ngo twegere Imana dushize ubwoba, tubiheshejwe n'uko tumwizeye.

13.text: Ni cyo gituma mbinginga ngo mudacogozwa n'amakuba yanjye yo ku bwanyu, kuko ari yo cyubahiro cyanyu.

14.text: Ni cyo gituma mpfukamira Data wa twese,

15.text: uwo imiryango yose yo mu ijuru n'iyo mu isi yitirirwa,

16.text: ngo abahe nk'uko ubutunzi bw'ubwiza bwe buri gukomezwa cyane mu mitima yanyu ku bw'Umwuka we,

17.text: kandi ngo Kristo ahore mu mitima yanyu ku bwo kwizera, kugira ngo ubwo mumaze gushōrera imizi mu rukundo mukaba mushikamye,

18.text: muhabwe imbaraga zo kumenyera hamwe n'abera bose ubugari n'uburebure bw'umurambararo, n'uburebure bw'igihagararo, n'uburebure bw'ikijyepfo bwarwo ubwo ari bwo,

19.text: mumenye n'urukundo rwa Kristo ruruta uko rumenywa, ngo mwuzuzwe kugeza ku kuzura kw'Imana.

20.text: Nuko Ibasha gukora ibiruta cyane ibyo dusaba, ndetse n'ibyo twibwira byose nk'uko imbaraga zayo ziri zidukoreramo,

21.text: icyubahiro kibe icyayo mu Itorero no muri Kristo Yesu, kugeza iteka ryose ry'ibihe bidashira, Amen.
